en-GB.name: 4NextDart
en-GB.summary: Live Dublin DART train times for any station, plus a favourite stop you can ask about with one phrase.
en-GB.description:
This skill tells you the next Dublin DART trains from your chosen station, using the National Transport Authority's real-time data. DART is Dublin's coastal rail service between Howth or Malahide and Bray or Greystones.

Set or change your favourite stop by saying "Alexa, ask four next dart to set my favourite stop to Pearse southbound". Then simply asking "Alexa, ask four next dart" gives you your local trains. Get a reminder of your favourite stop by saying "Alexa, ask four next dart for my favourite stop". Get trains for any station by saying "Alexa, ask four next dart for Pearse southbound".

You can say northbound, southbound, going north, going south, towards the city, or towards a terminus such as Howth, Malahide, Bray, or Greystones.

Only DART trains are included, even at stations that also have Commuter or Intercity services.

Where live information is not available, timetable times are given instead.

Note: this is not an official Irish Rail, Iarnród Éireann, or TFI skill. It uses publicly available real-time information provided by the National Transport Authority.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask four next dart for Pearse southbound
Alexa, ask four next dart to set my favourite stop to Blackrock towards the city
Alexa, ask four next dart for the next train

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
No account linking. English (UK) locale. Ireland and UK distribution. This skill covers Dublin DART trains only (not Commuter or Intercity).

1. Ask four next dart for Pearse southbound. Expect DART times towards Bray or Greystones.
2. Ask four next dart to set my favourite stop. When prompted, say Blackrock going north. Expect confirmation of Blackrock northbound.
3. Ask four next dart for the next train. Expect the saved favourite.
4. Ask four next dart for Howth Junction towards Howth, and for Bray northbound.
5. Help and Stop should work.

Live times come from the NTA GTFS-Realtime feed; if live data is unavailable the skill says scheduled (timetable) times.
